NumericalError: GPU GLM did not produce a reliable fit: the float32 fit did not reach a stationary point (relative Newton decrement 1.32e-03 exceeds the float32 acceptance threshold 1e-06). This happens for ill-conditioned designs at large n in float32 — typically a log-link family (Poisson/Gamma) — where the float32 solve cannot locate the optimum (most often on Apple Silicon / MPS, which has no float64). PyStatistics does not silently substitute a CPU or lower-precision result; choose explicitly:
  - backend='cpu' for a correct double-precision fit (slower)
  - backend='gpu_fp64' on CUDA for an exact GPU fit
  - a ridge-penalized fit (a different, better-conditioned estimator)
  - force=True to return the float32 fit anyway (fast, but may be inaccurate / unstable)
